Decision by Matt Barge, 2026-09-25, relayed to the Claude Code session building the alpha-website-playbook QC cadence branch:

Depth: add a depth field per row (render or http) and a pageFamilies note: render for campus pages, home, locations and events pages; http for the long tail; the builder defaults from pageFamily. The observer (being changed in parallel) will read it; document the contract in spec/README.md.
